Två personer skadades i attacken, som sammanföll med ett besök i den ukrainska huvudstaden av den tyske förbundskanslern Friedrich Merz
events.summary_en: Russia attacked Kyiv's Northern Bridge, which is used by thousands of residents to cross the Dnipro River, on Sunday. Cars were on the bridge when the drone hit the carriageway and exploded. Two people were wounded in the strike, which coincided with a visit to the Ukrainian capital by the German chancellor, Friedrich Merz
